configurations.name: flowcheck-website
runtimeArgs: const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),base='backend/public';const MIME={html:'text/html',css:'text/css',js:'application/javascript',json:'application/json',png:'image/png',jpg:'image/jpeg',svg:'image/svg+xml',ico:'image/x-icon',woff2:'font/woff2',txt:'text/plain',xml:'application/xml'};const send=(res,p,d)=>{res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':MIME[p.split('.').pop().toLowerCase()]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(d)};require('http').createServer((req,res)=>{const url=decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]);let p=path.join(base,url==='/'?'index.html':url);if(!path.resolve(p).startsWith(path.resolve(base))){res.writeHead(403);return res.end('403')}fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(!e)return send(res,p,d);if(!path.extname(p)){const alt=p.replace(/\/$/,'')+'.html';return fs.readFile(alt,(e2,d2)=>{if(!e2)return send(res,alt,d2);const idx=path.join(p,'index.html');fs.readFile(idx,(e3,d3)=>e3?(res.writeHead(404),res.end('404')):send(res,idx,d3))})}res.writeHead(404);res.end('404')})}).listen(4323,()=>console.log('ready on 4323 (extensionless routing, mirrors express.static extensions:[html])'))
